title: Financial Leak Detection
equation: Leak Rate = Hidden Costs ÷ Total Spending
hook: That forgotten $29 tool isn't the problem. Its twelve cousins are.
statement: Money rarely dies in big mistakes. It leaks out quietly.
explainer: Dead subscriptions, tired ad spend, unused tools. Together they eat your margin.
sop: Flag every recurring charge and tool.
equation_example: Hidden Costs $400 ÷ Total Spending $4,000 = 10%. A dime of every dollar, wasted.
